title: 2009 AMC 10B Problem 10
statement: A flagpole is originally \(5\) meters tall. A hurricane snaps the flagpole at a point \(x\) meters above the ground so that the upper part, still attached to the stump, touches the ground \(1\) meter away from the base. What is \(x?\)

solutions.text:
The standing stump has height \(x,\) and the snapped piece of length \(5-x\) is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs \(x\) and \(1.\) By the Pythagorean Theorem, \[ \begin{aligned} x^2+1^2 &= (5-x)^2 \\ &= x^2-10x+25, \end{aligned} \] so \(10x=24\) and \(x=2.4.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: The broken piece has length \(5-x\) and forms the hypotenuse
